title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with standout jams (Schoolgirl, New Speedway Boogie, China Cat→Rider) captured on a mostly clean soundboard recording that suffers from slight hiss and occasional drop‑outs.
ai_review.review: The performance shines in the electric half – Jerry tears into Schoolgirl on his Sunburst Strat, the band delivers a ripping New Speedway Boogie and a soaring China Cat → Rider sequence, while acoustic moments are hit‑or‑miss for some listeners. The soundboard source is generally clear and lively but is marred by a faint hiss, occasional cuts, bass drop‑outs and tuning slips that keep it from being pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical highlights and rate the show 4‑5 stars, but a sizable minority note serious audio flaws (hiss, cuts, tuning issues) and weak acoustic portions, pulling the overall weighted rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall mix with a faint hiss; occasional drop‑outs and bass disappearance; some noticeable tuning problems on China Cat; generally listenable despite imperfections.

poor_songs: The Weight (cut after a few words)
show_quality.setlist_flow: An acoustic‑electric hybrid set; the acoustic section divides opinion, while the electric second half builds strong momentum with tight jams and classic transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Rips on Schoolgirl with his Sunburst Strat; noted for using pedal steel in the acoustic set (speculative).
band_member_comments.Bob: Funny banter captured at the show’s start, but no specific musical critique.
